title: Git sync
readOnlyNote: The repository is only read. Levelrail never writes anything back to it.
rootOnly: Only an administrator can change the sync settings.

refresh.hint: Fetches the repository and plans one run now.

codes.sync_repo_unreachable: The repository could not be fetched, or its credential could not be used.
codes.sync_path_invalid: The sync path leaves the checkout, points into .git or holds a symlink.
codes.sync_limits_exceeded: The repository or the files under the sync path passed a size or file count limit.
codes.sync_plan_failed: The documents under the sync path did not validate or could not be planned.
codes.sync_secret_in_repo: A document in the repository holds a literal secret. Use a secret reference instead, then rotate the leaked value.
codes.sync_disk_low: Free disk was too low, so nothing was fetched.
codes.sync_apply_failed: An apply was refused or failed and the stack was left unchanged.

form.credentialHint: The name of an app connection. Token values are never shown.
form.webhookOnlyHint: No polling, a push to the repository starts a run.
form.enabledHint: Plans the repository on a schedule or on a webhook.
form.applyHint: Apply the planned changes to the stack. Off means plan only.
form.pruneHint: Delete resources that left the repository. This removes things.
form.deployHint: Redeploy apps after an apply. This restarts running apps.
form.saveFailed: Could not save the sync settings

approval.required: This stack requires approval. A sync that finds changes creates a pending approval and never approves itself.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.confirmBody: The old secret stops working as soon as you confirm. Update the webhook in your git provider with the new one.
webhook.once: This will not be shown again. Copy it now.

secretsRefused: A document that holds a plaintext secret is refused with sync_secret_in_repo. Keep secrets in the secrets API and refer to them by name.
